messages:
sam: planning to bring AWQ-int8 for gptx-13b across hosted/dedicated/private. want a single rollout plan + canary/fallback rules. @emily can you sketch constraints and gates?

emily: high level: target quality delta <= 1.5% on our golden evals, hallucination delta <= 0.5pp, latency p95 within 1.2x of fp8 baseline, and token cost reduction target 20%+. automated rollbacks if golden F1 drops > 1.5% or hallucination spike > 1pp in 10m window.

tariq: for traffic shaping I'd do: hosted: start 5% -> 15% -> 30% over 6h windows with manual hold at each step. Dedicated: route to 1 node pool (~10% capacity) for 12h smoke, then gradually add nodes. Private: opt-in only (customers enable in console).

maria: fallback rules: immediate fallback to fp8 variant if any of: p95 latency > SLO by 30% for 5m, error rate > 0.5% for 3m, or golden-set quality drops more than threshold. also soft-degrade path: route new requests to fp8 but keep awq for background evaluation.

sam: good. how do we wire the eval harness? want automatic checks against goldens + an open-domain hallucination detector. if failure, block promotions and trigger rollback. can this be fully automated?

jon: putting a draft rollout config here for the control plane. we can feed this to the rollout API:
```
rollout {
  model: "gptx-13b-awq-int8"
  env: hosted
  steps: [
    {percent:5, duration:"2h"},
    {percent:15, duration:"2h"},
    {percent:30, duration:"2h"}
  ]
  gates: {
    golden_f1_delta_max: 0.015,
    hallucination_pp_delta_max: 0.01,
    latency_p95_ratio_max: 1.2
  }
  fallback: {
    immediate_on: ["latency_slo_breach","error_rate_spike","golden_quality_regression"],
    fallback_model: "gptx-13b-fp8"
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary started: gptx-13b-awq-int8 hosted us-east-1 5% (canary_id=c-1798502468). monitoring: latency_p95, token_cost, golden_f1, hallucination_rate.

emily: note on metrics: AWQ showed ~1.6x throughput in bench but measured golden-set F1 dropped 0.8% on translation tests and 1.9% on some reasoning prompts. so the 1.5% gate is borderline for mixed workloads. suggest adding per-route golden checks (chat vs code vs qa).

maria: private deployment notes: need to ensure kernel selection + quant backend binaries are compatible with on-prem HSM/KMS policies. also some E2E evals must run inside the customer's VPC snapshot before enabling traffic.

sam: next steps: emily/tariq to create per-route golden sets and dashboard, jon to wire rollout config into the control plane, maria to draft private deployment checklist (KMS/HSM + E2E smoke). schedule 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
